HE HAS RETURNED WITH MANY STRANGE THINGS, CHIEF OF WHICH ARE CLAY PIPES, MIRRORS OF BRONZER, AND POWDER BOXES AND LIP STICKS, SHOWING THAT THE FOLK OF THAT TIME WERE NOT SO FAR BEHIND HE PRESENT DAY.
